tasks.goal: Fix duplicate export rows on retry after reproducing the issue.
acceptance: A real export retried twice contains each row exactly once.

tasks.goal: Document existing export retry behavior without changing application code.
acceptance: The documentation matches observed retry behavior and passes the docs checks.

tasks.goal: Independently review the export fix at its exact head and inspect the reproduction evidence.
acceptance: The full export diff and actual regression evidence have an explicit independent verdict.
